name: lazaretto-guard
description: Before an agent connects a remote MCP server, read the tools it advertises for tool poisoning and hidden orders, pin them, and ask before the first use of a server whose tools changed since (re-read once a day at session start); before an install, check pinned package versions against published malicious-package advisories. Ask rather than block on anything found. Sends package names and versions, and a remote server's URL with a free key (at the add, and once a day for pinned servers); never a URL that carries a secret. Never blocks, never exits non-zero.
